integrity: Theorems have analytic Lyapunov and exact sign proofs supplemented by independently executable symbolic and numerical checks. The motivating 2006 publication is prior work, not a publication date for the proposed finding. Priority is provisional because not all plausible earlier full texts were available.
scientific_limitations: Stationary equal-time Pearson correlation of centered linear two-patch Gaussian fluctuations only; ideal reciprocal dispersal and fixed relaxation/noise amplitudes. The perfect-correlation criterion presumes exactly shared Brownian forcing; full-rank noise supports two stationary turning points but not perfect correlation. General-parameter uniqueness of the post-synchronization minimum is not asserted. No inference to nonnegative nonlinear populations, persistence, or extinction.
title: Finite-dispersal synchronization and reentrant desynchronization in a heterogeneous two-patch model
